[3/4] Difficulty engine, CLI/API and Web selector green; 409 tests
[1/4] Add three difficulty modes with trace, starting-condition and contract-pay modifiers

impact_assessment.why: Every run used the same trace curve and contract economy, so experienced players had no explicit challenge dial and newer players had no gentler entry point.
impact_assessment.benefits: Easy and Hard create replayable challenge levels, persist in the archive and leaderboard, and isolate balance changes in one module.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine/save/history payloads gain a difficulty field and the API reset accepts one; dependency: none; concurrency: one run per session; state: normal must remain byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged and old saves must default to normal.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize unknown values to normal, keep Normal multipliers at 1.0, apply modifiers in central trace/payout methods, persist the field, and cover both non-normal and default paths with tests.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Difficulty modes complete; project gate 5/5, 409 tests; checklists: passed
Task 'task-cyberpulse-difficulty' completed successfully.
[1/3] Add a first-run field manual tracking scan, probe, breach, loot and extraction

impact_assessment.why: New players face 50 commands and many systems with only static help; there is no live checklist showing the core loop or what they have already done.
impact_assessment.benefits: A state-driven checklist teaches the loop in order, reduces first-run abandonment, and disappears once the player has settled a run.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState gains a scanned flag and state payloads gain a tutorial list; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only progress; state: old saves default unscanned and established careers should never see the panel.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Derive each step from existing persisted state, set the scan flag only on a successful scan, hide the guide for any career with settled runs, and cover step transitions plus CLI/API payloads with tests.

[1/4] Give each daily run a deterministic rule modifier shown across both interfaces

impact_assessment.why: Daily runs vary by seed but not by rules, so the daily challenge lacks a distinct identity or reason to compare strategies.
impact_assessment.benefits: A date-selected modifier changes the run constraints, makes daily results more memorable, and adds replay variety without affecting normal runs.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine/save/history gain a daily modifier id and daily starts accept it; dependency: none; concurrency: one modifier per run; state: old saves and normal runs must have no modifier, and daily runs loaded from saves must retain it.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Select from a fixed deterministic table by date, apply only in daily mode, persist the id through saves, keep normal defaults empty, and cover selection, effects, persistence, CLI and API paths with tests.

checkpoints.description: [3/4] Daily modifier selection, engine effects, persistence, CLI/API/Web display green; 416 tests
[4/4] Daily rule modifiers complete; project gate 5/5, 416 tests; checklists: passed
Task 'task-cyberpulse-daily-modifiers' completed successfully.
[1/3] Add difficulty filters to the career Hall of Fame in terminal and Web

impact_assessment.why: Hall entries record difficulty, but the leaderboard mixes Easy, Normal and Hard scores as if they were comparable, which flattens the value of both modes and rankings.
impact_assessment.benefits: Filtered leaderboards show the best run per difficulty, make difficulty-specific goals legible, and give the new modes a fair competitive surface.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new read-only CLI filter and Web controls, no schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only; state: old hall entries without difficulty must default to normal and existing all-time view must remain default.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default every filter path to all, treat missing difficulty as normal, validate CLI filters, keep the underlying hall unchanged, and cover all/filtered/legacy entries plus JS syntax with tests.

[3/3] Alias command/API, Web alias editor and persisted preferences green; 420 tests
[1/3] Add a persistent career alias and remembered Web presentation preferences

impact_assessment.why: The dossier alias was fixed at ZeroCool and the Web theme, audio and CRT controls reset on every reload, so players could not personalize their identity or keep a preferred presentation.
impact_assessment.benefits: A lasting handle improves ownership of the dossier, persisted preferences reduce repeated setup, and reduced-motion support improves accessibility.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: alias mutations touch career.json, while Web preferences stay client-side; dependency: none; concurrency: single-user profile saves; state: old careers must sanitize to ZeroCool and unavailable localStorage must fall back silently.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize the alias on read and write, cap it at 24 characters, save profile atomically, wrap preference storage in try/catch, and cover CLI, API, normalization and default paths with tests.
